name: MULTIGRAIN ENERGY BAR CHOCOLATE CHUNK NUT
ingredients_raw: Whole Grains 40.2% (Oats Flour, Millets 11% (Samal Flakes, Jowar Flakes), Rolled Oats, Rice Flakes), Fructo-oligosaccha - rides, Dark Chocolato Paste 10% (Sugar, Edible Vegetable Fat, Cocos Solids, Soy Lecithin & Natural Vanilla), Date Syrup, Almond Butter 5%, Millets 5% (Jowar Crispy), Dates Paste, Honey, Cocoa Powder, Peanut Butter, Seeds 2% (Sunflower, Chia), Glycerin, Natural Flavors (Chocolate, Rosemary Extract), Gum Acacia.
